channel.title: Threat Desk
channel.description: Vulnerabilities, advisories and threat activity, twice a day

item.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
item.description: Broadcom has released emergency patches for a critical authentication bypass in VMware vCenter Server, which Mandiant says was exploited in zero-day attacks by a suspected Chinese state-sponsored group since September 2026.

item.title: Bell Canada confirms 'agentic' actor stole enterprise data
item.description: Bell Canada confirmed that an 'agentic' threat actor breached its Maximo system on 17 November 2026, exfiltrating enterprise customer details including IP addresses and contact information.

item.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to expose tenant metadata
item.description: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to steal administrator email addresses and tenant configuration data, prompting Microsoft to deploy a server-side fix.

item.title: Unit 42 tracks Com-affiliated vishing campaigns targeting data-rich sectors
item.description: Unit 42 has documented recent waves of voice phishing attacks by Com-affiliated actors that resulted in data theft and extortion attempts across financial, healthcare, and legal services.

item.title: GL.iNet cloud flaw exploited to install malware on routers
item.description: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud platform to deploy custom malware and reverse shells on customer routers and KVM devices.

item.title: Java4Shell RCE in OpenJDK affects Cisco and Palo Alto products
item.description: Oracle has released fixes for a critical buffer overflow in the Base64 decoder that allows remote code execution on x86-64 systems with AVX-512 support.

item.title: Ruby patches 'Ruby2Shell' heap overflow with RCE potential
item.description: Ruby has released updates for seven vulnerabilities, including a heap-based buffer overflow in string case conversion that allows unauthenticated remote code execution in specific single-byte encodings.

item.title: F5 releases emergency patches for five critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
item.description: F5 has issued out-of-band hotfixes for five critical stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities in BIG-IP APM and iRules that allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: SBC Medical Group breach exposes data of 2m Japanese individuals
item.description: A data breach affecting over two million individuals in Japan has been disclosed by SBC Medical Group, with attackers accessing basic personal information, employee credentials, and credit card details.

item.title: n0n claims breach of Qubole exposed Chase, Visa, Mastercard data
item.description: The n0n ransomware group alleges it stole marketing and customer data from cloud analytics firm Qubole, affecting J.P. Morgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard.

item.title: WhatsApp patches IP leak flaw uncovered while disrupting scam campaign
item.description: WhatsApp has fixed a low-severity vulnerability in its Android apps that it believes a scammer may have exploited to make scam messages seem more credible.

item.title: West Virginia Legislature IT systems hit by cyber incident
item.description: The West Virginia state legislature has disabled access to certain IT systems following a cyber incident that began on Thursday, with no group yet claiming responsibility.

item.title: China-linked actor uses AI agents to exploit MONAI Label zero-day
item.description: Amazon Threat Intelligence reports that autonomous AI agents, operated by a China-linked threat actor, discovered and exploited a critical path traversal vulnerability in MONAI Label to gain root access to university servers.

item.title: YMCA Singapore Youth For Causes portal breached
item.description: The YMCA of Singapore confirmed a cybersecurity breach affecting its Youth For Causes application portal and associated database, exposing personal data including NRIC numbers.

item.title: PHP releases updates for 18 flaws, including critical RCE bugs
item.description: The PHP development team has released security updates for all supported branches to address 18 vulnerabilities, including critical remote code execution flaws exploitable by unauthenticated attackers.

item.title: BADBOX 3.0 botnet returns with 40 billion daily ad requests
item.description: HUMAN researchers report that the BADBOX malware botnet has returned, generating a record 40 billion fraudulent bid requests per day from infected Android devices.

item.title: Rackspace Spot breach exposed customer Kubernetes secrets
item.description: Attackers used leaked credentials to access the Rackspace Spot cloud platform, allowing them to read sensitive Kubernetes Secrets and deploy unauthorized workloads in customer clusters.

item.title: Latvian telecom leak exposes 125m SMS records
item.description: The Latvian branch of CSC Telecom left a database containing over 125 million SMS messages exposed, affecting clients of Swedbank, SEB, airBaltic, and dozens of other companies.

item.title: Signal blocks AI assistants from capturing chats on iOS and Android
item.description: Signal has introduced protections to prevent Siri and Gemini from accessing private conversations, citing the risk of sensitive data leaving the app's control.

item.title: Cleverbridge breach exposes payment card numbers and CVVs
item.description: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge confirmed that attackers stole customer payment card data, including CVV codes, after detecting unauthorised activity in early November.

item.title: Chinese hackers use Cairn AI to find zero-day in medical imaging app
item.description: Amazon Threat Intelligence says a Chinese-nexus actor allegedly used the autonomous AI tool Cairn to discover and exploit an unpatched path traversal flaw in MONAI Label, breaching East Asian universities.

item.title: FBI investigating apparent breach of National Crime Information Center
item.description: The FBI is investigating a second reported intrusion in two months, this time targeting the NCIC database used for sharing criminal justice records across US law enforcement.

item.title: Race condition in Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime allows admin account creation
item.description: CISA has issued an advisory for a high-severity race condition in Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime that permits the creation of unauthenticated administrator accounts.

item.title: CISA flags unpatched integer underflow in libumqtt
item.description: CISA has issued an advisory for an integer underflow vulnerability in libumqtt that allows remote denial of service, memory corruption, or information disclosure, with no vendor fix available.

item.title: CISA warns of flaws in Elecbrakes trailer controllers
item.description: Three vulnerabilities in Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, and ELBC2000 devices could allow attackers to manipulate trailer brakes or firmware via Bluetooth.

item.title: Cisco warns of eMudhra CA compromise affecting multiple products
item.description: Cisco has issued an emergency advisory after a critical compromise of eMudhra certificate authorities rendered eight intermediate certificates vulnerable to brute-force key recovery.

item.title: CISA adds four actively exploited vulnerabilities to KEV Catalog
item.description: CISA has listed four new vulnerabilities in its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog, including critical flaws in VMware vCenter, Cisco Expressway, and Apache Roller.
